options.reason: The table is a sample-by-gene RNA-seq matrix assembled to predict HER2 status, and the label column is a binary 0/1 outcome (107 negative, 15 positive), so this is a binary classification task on gene expression features. sample_id is a row key and must be excluded from features; all remaining 20k+ columns are expression values measured before the outcome, so none is leakage. No group or time structure is present, so both are left empty. Class imbalance makes discrimination at the positive class the priority, hence the requested PR-AUC emphasis.
